display_long_description:
In the 2020s of the 21st century, humanity discovered the existence of a parallel universe that exists in balance and opposition to our physical reality—later defined as the Metaverse. With rapid technological advancement, humans invented an ultra-smart pair of glasses capable of connecting the real world with the Metaverse, aiming to unlock the gateway to this new realm. However, the Metaverse turned out not to be the utopia people had imagined—a hidden crisis was quietly unfolding...

You play as the director of a botanical garden, home to a magical plant known as the Sun Tree. This extraordinary tree produces sunlight, providing vital energy for life. It seems the "visitors" from the Metaverse are particularly interested in it...
